title: The picture picker answers through Gemini Decision 1 when its door is assigned that model
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Each frame is one choice question among its own photos and other; each photo is sent once at low resolution.
A fix round asks only the frames its failure list names, without the photos picked for them before.
A 429 is waited out; a refusal is a failed turn; any other door model keeps the chat picker.

tests: each frame is one choice among its own photos and "other"; the photos follow once each, after their code
a fix round asks only the frames its failure list names, without the photos picked for them before
a rate limit is waited out and asked again; a refusal fails the turn with the endpoint status
the picture step answers through Decision 1 only when its door is assigned that model
